apps.author: sfsakhawat999
apps.name: mpvRex
apps.changeLog:
mpvRex v4.2.1 introduces manual video zoom and pan controls, unified view option toggles across sort dialogs, deconflicted panning gestures, and essential stability and navigation fixes.

---

### ✨ New Features

*   **Manual Zoom & Pan Sliders:** Added interactive sliders for Zoom and Horizontal Pan adjustments inside the Aspect Ratio Sheet. Toggling the "Custom..." chip dynamically reveals custom aspect ratio inputs.

---

### 🛠️ Fixed & Improved

#### **Preferences & UI Refinements**
*   **Unified View Option Toggles:** Standardized the availability and order of the 12 visibility preference toggles (such as Path, Duration, Resolution, Date, Progress Bar, and Subtitle Indicator) across Folder, Video, and FileSystem sort dialogs.

#### **Gestures & Controls**
*   **Panning Deconfliction:** Resolved an issue where single-finger panning when zoomed conflicted with vertical swipe gestures for volume, brightness, or seeking.

#### **Browser & Navigation**
*   **View Mode Navigation:** Automated popping to the root backstack when changing view modes, and enabled view option toggles inside Tree subdirectories.
*   **Auto-scroll Persistence:** Fixed a bug where auto-scrolling to the last played video reset the scroll state on back navigation.
*   **Tree Mode Playlist Sorting:** Fixed playlist playback order in Tree mode by correctly sorting sibling files using tree sorting preferences.

#### **Documentation**
*   **Weblate Translations:** Added a dedicated translations contribution section to the project README.
*   **Feature Overview:** Refined, modernized, and organized the feature presentation inside the main README file.

apps.changeLog:
## Version 13.6.0

### New Features
- Added a self-healing, remote-updatable config system synced with [zemer-cipher](https://github.com/ZemerTeam/zemer-cipher) from [zemer-app](https://github.com/ZemerTeam/zemer-app) for more reliable streaming — @alltechdev & @mostafaalagamy

### Improvements & Performance
- Faster artist screen loading, with a shimmer while it loads — @adrielGGmotion
- Faster playback start and app relaunch — @alltechdev
- Reduced startup blocking by batch-reading settings — @adrielGGmotion
- Cleaner cache size display — @kairosci · Correct FAB position in search — @il-Luca

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed several crashes: duplicate Home Screen items (@kairosci, @isotjs), audio recognition resampler (@adrielGGmotion), playback freeze loops on network errors (@kairosci)
- Fixed artist name parsing and duration extraction — @kairosci
- Fixed playback cache marking — @mostafaalagamy · download stalls — @kairosci · backup/restore compatibility — @kairosci
- Fixed search query encoding — @Scott-Nx · empty playlist/pagination bug — @kairosci
- Restored artist links on the album screen — @adrielGGmotion
- Streaming/cipher reliability fixes (config updates, self-heal, WebView rebuild) — @alltechdev; Apple Music token regex — @adrielGGmotion; Zemer config sync — @mostafaalagamy
- Refactored Discord Rich Presence (pure Kotlin) — @adrielGGmotion & @CommandCodeBot

## New Contributors
* @brb-fr made their first contribution in https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/Metrolist/pull/3948
* @Scott-Nx made their first contribution in https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/Metrolist/pull/3886
* @il-Luca made their first contribution in https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/Metrolist/pull/3890

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MetrolistGroup/Metrolist/compare/v13.5.0...v13.6.0

apps.author: jean-voila
apps.name: Instagram
apps.changeLog:
# Feurstagram — Instagram 435.0.0.37.76 🎉

This release brings in-app updates, a new "Following feed only" mode, smarter ad-blocking, and a more convenient way to open the settings.

## ✨ New features

### 📥 In-app updates
Feurstagram can now **download and install** updates directly from within the app. When a new version is available, just tap **Update** — the APK is fetched and handed to the system installer, no browser required.

### 🔔 Automatic update checker
On every launch, Feurstagram asks GitHub for the latest release and shows a prompt if your build is out of date. Enabled by default and toggleable from the new **Updates** section of the settings page (this toggle is never frozen by the permanent lock).

### 🏠 "Following feed only" mode
A softer alternative to blocking the Home feed entirely: leave the feed unblocked, turn this on, and the home feed returns **only chronological posts from accounts you follow** — no ranked or recommended content. Off by default.

### 🚫 Better ad-blocking
In addition to network-level blocking, ad and promo units injected **inline into the feed** (e.g. `ad4ad`, intent-aware pivots, multi-ad pivots) are now dropped at parse time, so they no longer slip through.

### 🙅 Suggested accounts toggle
A dedicated toggle that blocks account/user recommendations across the app — profile "Suggested for you", stories-tray injected accounts, search null-state recs, post-follow chaining, and friend/business suggestions. **Blocked by default.**

### ⚙️ New settings button
A dedicated Feurstagram settings button now appears in the top action bar, right next to the notifications (heart) icon — alongside the existing long-press-Home-tab shortcut.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Permanent lock no longer freezes a surface the instant its switch is flipped.** The blocked-state is now snapshotted when the settings page opens, so a surface toggled on by mistake during a session can be turned back off until **Done** restarts the app. Previously a stray tap (e.g. Stories) was locked in immediately and forced a reinstall.

## 🔧 Under the hood

- 📱 Updated base app to **Instagram 435.0.0.37.76**.
- 🛠️ Migrated the patching toolkit from apktool/smali to the **Morphe fingerprint patcher** for cleaner, more maintainable, version-resilient builds.

Version 1.6.2 (2022-03-15)
==========================

Download Navi always strives to be completely free (libre) software, so RAR decompression support has been removed due to a nonfree license.

Version 1.6.1 (2022-02-13)
==========================

 * Bugfixing:
      - Background work on Android 12 (requires disabling battery optimization for the app)
      - Decoding multibyte characters in the filename (like ş or ö)
      - JSON type recognition on Android 9 and below
 * Updated current translations

Version 1.6 (2022-02-05)
========================

 * Added:
      - Auto-uncompress archive option (Android 8.0+)
      - Notifications about the file moving and checksum validation error
 * Improved filename parsing from URL
 * Temporary HTTP redirects are now saved as permanent
 * Bugfixing:
      - Android 10 storage access
      - Getting the gzip archives length
      - Progress notification visibility after re-running
 * New translations:
      - Malay
      - Swedish
      - Tamil
 * Updated current translations

Version 1.5 (2021-10-09)
========================

 * Android 12 support
 * Hiding non-writable directories in the built-in file manager for Android 11+
 * [Browser] Mixed content compatibility mode enabled
 * Bugfixing:
      - Google Drive downloading with progress and pausing
      - Content-Disposition parsing and symbols escaping
      - [Browser] Data URI handling
      - [Browser] Redirecting to a non-valid URL
 * Added Norwegian (Bokmål) language
 * Updated current translations

Version 1.4 (2021-07-19)
========================

 * Android 11 support
 * Added:
      - Speed limit
      - [Browser] Hide browser icon option
 * More improved Content-Disposition parsing
 * Bugfixing:
      - Downloading files that requires Referer header
      - Handling "Do not ask again" of the permissions
      - Adding the .bin extension
      - [Browser] Cookies option
      - Crash on Android 8.0 if tap on the text field
      - Sites that require WWW in URL
      - Handling HTTP 307
